question: ithran is recorded with more than one father: dishon, dishon-2.
note: The supplied verses do not conclusively distinguish which Dishon fathered Ithran: 1CH 1:41 repeats the name after naming Anah’s son, while the surrounding genealogy also names Seir’s son Dishon. GEN 36:26 reads Dishan in the Hebrew but Dishon in the KJV, so the apparent conflict cannot safely be resolved by merging or retargeting these records.
